content_zh:
“这件事很严肃，大家还是不要掉以轻心。邻省最近出的新闻，大家应该也听说了——”
中国这么大，新闻天天有，大家纷纷表示什么也没听说，尤其以住院狗为首，张主任只好叫身边的男人，“小解，要不还是你来说吧。说实话，发生了什么我也不太清楚。”
“那您最近是真忙了。”警察小解笑容可掬，虽然在这个房间里，没人的外貌能和某人比较，但也绝对是个帅哥，亲和度不知胜过师主任多少，“这个案子都已经上了新闻了——邻省最近破获了一起连续抢劫杀人案件，主犯大多落网，仅余两人潜逃在外，这是个有黑.社.会性质的犯罪团伙，罪行累累，犯下的案件正在陆续侦破之中，不过可以肯定的是，他们还牵涉到洗钱、走私这些经济犯罪，有深厚的海外关系。我们最后收到的线索，是这两人已经逃入我市，而且很可能有潜逃出境的计划——而且，在这两个案犯的窝点，我们发现了不少关于整容手术的搜索记录，他们同时还访问了上海多所知名整形医院的网页，警方有充足的理由，怀疑他们也许想要通过‘改头换面’的方法，配合新证件，光明正大地从边检出境逃离。”
话说到这里，小解的来意也就一清二楚了，他挨个给大家发照片，又加微信，“我叫解同和，大家加一下微信，有什么线索都可以立刻微信给我报告，当然打电话也欢迎——不过，我发现咱们年轻一代十有八.九都有电话恐惧症——”
“遇到医闹能不能找你？”有人冷不丁地问。
解同和眨眨眼，“别的科室还好，你们十九楼会有医闹吗？”
他语气逗趣，大家都笑，也就都上心地加了微信，亦不乏人不屑一顾，“通过整容手术改头换面，不是不可能，但至少要一年以上的手术期。他们想走，还不如通过特效化妆术，那不是更现实？”
解同和笑了，“就是因为有您这样聪明的人，特效化妆的材料才要严格管控——而且，这个骗不过边检，咱们以前看到的那些新闻，都是有特殊渠道过的边检。这种特效化妆是瞒不过肉眼的，倒是整容手术，如果真的被他们成功做了手术，改了指纹，那恐怕……”
“DNA证据没留存？”要糊弄医生可不容易，一个个遇到合适的机会就都客串起法医了。
“没有，我们也不可能遇到有几分相似的嫌疑人就先拘留下来做DNA。”解同和从容说，“而且最关键的是，有些知识对你们医生来说是常识，但嫌疑人却未必知道——他们有了这个想法很可能就会来试一试，至少先做做咨询，对吧？所以，我们警方也请大家为我们留心，如果近期有一些比较可疑的人来做大规模整容手术的咨询——”
犯罪嫌疑人关注过整容信息，警方肯定会来打招呼，这是他们尽职尽责的表现，但医生的反应则普遍很冷淡：“什么叫大规模整容手术？那个你要找烧伤科、修复科的，在楼下，我们这里现在都是微整形，午饭整形。做个鼻子就面目全非了？”
“想要面目全非也简单，就照着什么象鼻人、什么玻尿酸脸去整，这个保证有的，就不知道能不能过边检了。”
“哎，你还真别说，小申，我和你讲，要整成这样还很不容易，比整漂亮难。我们正规医生想做这种效果都做不出来，他不如去找美容院做。”
“我们都做不出来，美容院能做出来？他们那个是听天由命型的手术，能感染成什么样子，这要看患者个人的造化的。”
为这事还要把人叫回来，医生们情绪肯定不怎么高，笑话开完了总算说点正经事，“要说面目全非，那你找面部结构啊，就他们科能让人面目全非，对吧？面部结构呀，动得不好下半张脸都给你切没了，那还能不面目全非？”
“你们也是老熟人了，你直接找师子不就完了？去年12月我好像还看到你过来——就是为了那个什么面部还原吧？你看看你，也不是不懂行，还一定要浪费大家的时间。”
科室流动性大，几个月时间就又换了一拨人了，新人不免好奇，一阵低声询问：小解的自我介绍是对他们做的，和几个骨干医生则都是老熟人了。十六院改制以前有军警背景，市里第一个DNA刑事鉴定中心，第一个面部复原技术中心，都和院里有紧密关系，师主任虽然专做整容，但他在专业研究方面却是兼容并蓄，曾多次被警方邀请参与重大刑事案件的侦破活动，提供技术支持。“从前都是别的老警察来跑，小解来了就一直是小解过来——小解啊，你对象找好没有啊？都说了给你介绍了，总是推掉，你这个小伙子哪能回事啦？”

content_en:
"This matter is very serious. You should not take it lightly. You should have heard of the recent news from neighboring provinces——"
China is such a big country, and there is news every day. Everyone said they had heard nothing, especially the hospitalized dog. Director Zhang had no choice but to call the man next to him, "Xiaojie, why don't you tell me. To be honest, I don't know what happened."
"Then you've been really busy recently." Policeman Xiaojie smiled brightly. Although no one in this room could compare with someone else's appearance, he was definitely a handsome guy, and his friendliness was much better than that of the division director. "This case has already been on the news - neighboring province Recently, a serial robbery and murder case was solved. Most of the main culprits were arrested, and only two people were absconding. This is a criminal gang with a mafia nature. It has committed numerous crimes and the cases it committed are being investigated one after another. However, it is certain that they are also involved in other crimes. Involved in economic crimes such as money laundering and smuggling, they have deep overseas connections. The last clue we received is that these two people have fled into our city and may have plans to abscond from the country. Moreover, we found a lot of information about these two criminals in their lairs. They also visited the web pages of many well-known plastic surgery hospitals in Shanghai. The police had sufficient reasons to suspect that they might want to "change their appearance" and use new documents to escape from the border openly. "
At this point, Xiao Jie's purpose became clear. He sent photos to everyone one by one and added WeChat, "My name is Xie Tonghe. If you add WeChat, if you have any clues, you can report to me immediately via WeChat. Of course, you are welcome to call - but I found that nine out of ten of our younger generation have phone phobia -"
"Can I come to you if I encounter a medical problem?" someone asked abruptly.
Jie Tonghe blinked, "Other departments are fine. Will there be any medical trouble on your 19th floor?"
His tone was funny, and everyone laughed, so they all added WeChat with sincerity, and some people were dismissive, "It is not impossible to change your face through plastic surgery, but it will take at least a year of surgery. If they want to leave, they might as well use special effects makeup. Isn't that more realistic?"
Xie Tonghe smiled, "It is because of smart people like you that the materials for special effects makeup must be strictly controlled - and this cannot be fooled by border inspections. The news we have seen before was all border inspections through special channels. This kind of special effects makeup cannot be hidden from the naked eye, but it is plastic surgery. If they really successfully performed the surgery and changed the fingerprints, then I'm afraid..."
"No DNA evidence preserved?" It's not easy to fool the doctor. Every time they meet the right opportunity, they will play a guest role as forensic doctors.
"No, it's impossible for us to detain suspects who are somewhat similar and do DNA testing first." Xie Tonghe said, "And the most important thing is that some knowledge is common sense to your doctors, but the suspects may not know it - they will probably give it a try if they have this idea, at least for consultation first, right? Therefore, our police also ask everyone to pay attention to us. If there are some suspicious people coming to consult for large-scale plastic surgery recently -"
The suspect has paid attention to plastic surgery information, and the police will definitely come to say hello. This is a sign of their conscientiousness, but the doctor's response is generally cold: "What is large-scale plastic surgery? You need to go to the burn department and restorative department. Downstairs, we now only have micro plastic surgery and lunch plastic surgery. Just a nose change and it will be completely unrecognizable?"
"If you want to change your face beyond recognition, it's easy. Just have it shaped like a man with an elephant trunk or a hyaluronic acid face. If you have this guarantee, I don't know if you can pass the border inspection."
"Hey, don't say it, Xiao Shen. Let me tell you, it's not easy to have plastic surgery like this. It's more difficult than to have beautiful plastic surgery. We regular doctors can't achieve this kind of effect even if they want to. HeIt's better to go to a beauty salon to do it. "
“We can’t do it, how can a beauty salon do it? Their surgery is a fateful one, and the extent of the infection depends on the patient's personal destiny. "
The doctors had to call people back for this matter, and the doctors were definitely not in a high mood. After the jokes, they finally talked about something serious, "If you want to say that it is beyond recognition, then you look at the facial structure. They are the only ones who can make people change beyond recognition, right?" Facial structure, if you don’t move it well, the lower half of your face will be cut off. How can you avoid being completely unrecognizable? "
"You are already old acquaintances, wouldn't it be over if you just go to the master? I think I saw you coming here in December last year - just for that facial restoration, right? Look at you, it’s not like you don’t know how to do it, you still want to waste everyone’s time. "
The department has a high turnover, and a new group of people has changed within a few months. The newcomers can't help but be curious, and ask in low voices: Xiaojie introduced himself to them, and he and several key doctors are all old acquaintances. Before the restructuring of the Sixteenth Hospital, he had a military and police background. The city’s first DNA criminal identification center and the first facial restoration technology center were all closely related to the hospital. Although the division director specializes in plastic surgery, he is eclectic in professional research. He has been invited by the police many times to participate in the detection of major criminal cases and provide technical support. "In the past, other old policemen would come here. When Xiaojie came, it was always Xiaojie who came here - Xiaojie, have you found a partner yet? I've already said I'd introduce it to you, but I always turn it down. What's wrong with a young man like you? "
